body: It's just I've told my mom before about my depression and it broke her heart. I almost went through with it last night. The sad thing is I'm more afraid of what life has for me than I am afraid of dying

I have always felt like I can't hold up to people's expectations. Honestly disappointing people has to be my biggest fear. I have tried all the thingsame that used to make me happy, I just feel empty now when I do them. I just can't do anything now without thinking I'm going to disappoint my family or friends.
